subject: Handoff plan & demo timing for AcuMed — evening overlap
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Helen Park <h.park@acumed.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 20:12:00 -0400
Subject: Intro: AcuMed demo - preferred time windows

Hi team — looping you both in. Quick context: AcuMed (Helen) is a mid-stage digital health buyer; discovery went well and they asked for a technical demo focused on privacy controls and routing. Helen prefers late afternoon ET next week due to their executive schedules.

Helen, thanks again for the time earlier — you mentioned 5pm ET on Tue/Thu works best. I tentatively penciled Tue 5pm ET (that’s 21:00 CET / 04:00 AEST next day for APAC folks).

Ask for internal folks:
- Marissa / Sofia: can we coordinate a handoff so the EU AE can wrap and own EMEA follow-ups?
- I can do discovery + first 30 min, then transfer to Sofia for feature deep-dive and next steps.

Attached: AcuMed-MAP-v3.pdf (high level timeline & stakeholders).

Thanks — Logan

--
Logan Wright
SDR, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Helen Park <h.park@acumed.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 21:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro: AcuMed demo - preferred time windows

Thanks, Logan — good context. Two quick suggestions to keep the customer happy while protecting AE bandwidth across time zones:

Option A (preferred): shift the live demo 60 minutes earlier to 4pm ET. That moves the session to 20:00 CET — still late for EMEA, but more reasonable for Sofia to join and own the wrap.

Option B: keep the 5pm ET slot. Logan does the live discovery + demo peak (45 min), Sofia joins 15 minutes before the scheduled end for a live handoff and then does a 30-minute recorded follow-up for EMEA stakeholders who can’t attend. We’ll follow up with a short summary + action items within 24h.

Either way, I recommend a 15-minute pre-demo sync between Logan and Sofia starting 30 minutes before the customer session to run the runbook:
- who leads each segment
- critical questions & redlines (privacy/KMS/QoS)
- who owns next steps in HubSpot

I added a short handoff checklist (handoff-cheatsheet.md) and a calendar stub: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acu-demo-20270504-prehandoff — please confirm which option works for the customer.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Helen Park <h.park@acumed.com>

Cc: AcuMed Product Team <product@acumed.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 01:28:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Intro: AcuMed demo - preferred time windows

Hi all — thanks for the options. We cannot move earlier on Tue due to exec schedules. 5pm ET / Tue works best for us (that’s 21:00 CET).

We appreciate the handoff plan — a 15-min pre-demo sync sounds good as long as it’s just internal. Sofia, if you can join live at the tail end that’d be ideal. If not, a short recorded follow-up and a written summary with action items is fine.

Please send calendar invites and the brief agenda so our security & product folks know what to expect.

Best,
Helen

Helen Park
Head of Product Ops, AcuMed
h.park@acumed.com

Great — thanks for confirming, Helen. We’ll keep Tue 5:00pm ET. Finalized plan below: 

- 16:45 ET / 21:45 CET: internal pre-demo sync (15 min) — Logan + Sofia + Marissa (quick checklist)
- 17:00 ET / 22:00 CET: customer demo (Logan leads discovery + product demo)
- 17:45 ET / 22:45 CET: Sofia joins live for wrap and next-step alignment (if available). If Sofia needs to step in asynchronously, we’ll record the last 20 minutes and send a written summary within 12 hours.

Action items: 
- Logan: confirm meeting link, share slide deck (demo-slide-deck.pptx) and runbook in the invite (done).
- Sofia: please review the two privacy Qs in the MAP and flag any redlines.
- Marissa: I’ll owner the HubSpot task and the mutual action plan (ACU-4721). Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACU-4721

I created calendar events for the pre-demo sync and the customer demo (links above). Attaching the handoff checklist for quick reference.

Thanks — looking forward.

Marissa
